title: Application FTP Vsftpd Entity
description: Vsftpd-specific configuration. Extends Application/FTP with vsftpd-specific settings.

write_enable.description: Whether to allow write commands (upload, delete, mkdir, etc.).

local_umask.description: Umask for file creation by local users (e.g., '022').

chroot_local_user.description: Whether to chroot local users to their home directory.

allow_writeable_chroot.description: Whether to allow writable chroot directories.

userlist_enable.description: Whether to enable the user list feature.

userlist_deny.description: If false, only users in userlist_file are allowed (whitelist mode).

userlist_file.description: Path to the user list file.

xferlog_file.description: Path to the transfer log file.

idle_session_timeout.description: Seconds before an idle session is disconnected.

data_connection_timeout.description: Seconds before a stalled data connection is closed.
